classification.difficultyReason: Locate the two stated reference angles and apply the side definitions using the right-angle mark; the triangle's orientation requires no additional method.

content.prompt: For the triangle opposite, name the opposite side, the adjacent side and the hypotenuse, using:

spec.description: X and Y lie on a horizontal top side; Z is below X. Ordinary source blue strokes become black.
spec.mathematics: Right angle at X; no numerical lengths supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied vertices and right-angle mark only.

answer.worked: $YZ$ is opposite the right angle at $X$, so it is the hypotenuse. Relative to the angle at $Y$, $XZ$ is opposite and $XY$ is adjacent.
